{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Final cleaned dataset
df_clean = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')
df_clean['revenue_clean'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
qa_mask = df_clean['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
df_clean = df_clean[~qa_mask].copy()
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['customer_age'] != -1]

# Cross-tabulate channel and customer_segment to check for confounding
ct = pd.crosstab(df_clean['channel'], df_clean['customer_segment'])
print('Cross-tabulation: channel vs customer_segment')
print(ct)

# Check conversion rate by channel, stratified by segment
grouped = df_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()
print('\nConversion rate by channel and segment:')
print(grouped)

# Check if the channel difference in conversion is driven by segment
# Email has higher share of loyal customers, who are more likely to convert
# We need to adjust for this to isolate campaign effect"}
